commands:
set -euo pipefail
SHA=8708f1905cdee6bd72d4de5ebdd7599582d589a0
BRANCH=work/photomap-straighten-20260912
git fetch origin "$BRANCH"
test "$(git rev-parse origin/$BRANCH)" = "$SHA"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
git merge --ff-only origin/$BRANCH
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$SHA"
cd frontend
npm run lint
npm run build
cd ..
VENV=$(mktemp -d /tmp/photomap-memory-owner-race-XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf "$VENV"; ./scripts/devctl.sh stop >/dev/null 2>&1 || true' EXIT
python3 -m venv "$VENV"
"$VENV/bin/python" -m pip install -q -r backend/requirements.txt
cd frontend
PYTHON="$VENV/bin/python" npm run test:e2e -- e2e/visual/memory-owner-delete-race.spec.ts e2e/visual/map.spec.ts --project=chromium --grep-invert 'visual:'
cd ..
git diff --check
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
trap - EXIT
rm -rf "$VENV"
./scripts/devctl.sh stop >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
